title: Certificates of Deposit: when a grace-period top-up to reach the jumbo bonus is available
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate in its grace period asks to add just enough money for the certificate to earn the jumbo bonus when it renews. It sets out when such a top-up is available at all.

## Rule

The top-up applies only when all three of the following hold:

1. **Grace actions still allowed.** The certificate's status is grace period, and no more than the tier's grace period length, in calendar days, has passed after the maturity date, counting the day after the maturity date as day 1.
2. **Renewing into its own tier.** The certificate will renew into its own tier when grace ends: its maturity instruction is automatic renewal, and its renewal tier is the tier it holds.
3. **Tier settings.** The tier offers the jumbo bonus and allows grace add-ons.

## Checklist

| Item | Passes when |
|---|---|
| Status | Grace period |
| Days after the maturity date | No more than the tier's grace period length |
| Maturity instruction | Automatic renewal |
| Renewal tier | The same tier the certificate holds |
| Jumbo bonus offered on the tier | Yes |
| Grace add-ons allowed on the tier | Yes |

## Boundary cases (illustrative grace length of 5 days, not a tier value)

Maturity date 1 October; the certificate is on automatic renewal into its own tier, on a tier that offers the jumbo bonus and allows grace add-ons.

| Current date | Days after maturity | Top-up available as to timing? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 October | 0 | Yes |
| 6 October | 5 | Yes, the last grace day is included |
| 7 October | 6 | No, grace actions are no longer allowed |

## Points of judgement

**The certificate's maturity instruction pays the balance out to savings. Is a jumbo top-up available?**
No. The certificate would not renew into its own tier when grace ends.

**The certificate's renewal tier is a different tier from the one it holds. Is a top-up available?**
No. The top-up applies only when the renewal tier is the tier the certificate holds.
